items.title: Peter LaCaze Interview, 1972-01-27
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Oh man, I don't know. Well he used to use Peter Boccage, Richard Payne, Bonk, either Buddy or Yannick, I can't remember which. ... [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah, well I don't know, but Buddy and Yannick, poor for some one player.

ctx.x: Who was playing that horn? Do you remember that? No, I don't know, I don't remember who was playing that horn. The only one I can remember playing the horn was that man Perez and the reason I remember him, because I was more interested in what he was doing than the balance of it. And what other bands did you remember around that time? Other bands, what I was supposed to play that time, well. This is before you started playing. Yeah, that was before I started playing. And I heard another one, I can remember the…
Oh man, I don't know. Well he used to use Peter Boccage, Richard Payne, Bonk, either Buddy or Yannick, I can't remember which. It must have been Buddy. I think Buddy was a better reader than Yannick.

Yeah, well I don't know, but Buddy and Yannick, poor for some one player. Yeah. Yeah. And Walter Brundy, I think you used. Walter Brundy was a drummer. Yeah. He worked with Roebeshaw for a long, long time. All the time I knew him used to work with John Roebeshaw.
